title: NIST WebBook: Calcium sulfate, anhydrous is CaO4S, molecular weight 136.141 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Calcium sulfate, anhydrous as CaO4S, molecular weight 136.141 amu, CAS 7778-18-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Calcium sulfate, anhydrous, CAS Registry Number 7778-18-9, lists molecular formula CaO4S and molecular weight 136.141 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 135.91432046 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Ca.H2O4S/c;1-5(2,3)4/h;(H2,1,2,3,4)/q+2;/p-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
